titles.title: the shell script runs: a windowed restore shows one page at the bottom with the bar, a page request round-trips and keeps the reader's place, a live row does not move a reader who scrolled up, and an old-style restore still works
the shell script bounds the view of a long active session: rows past the limit are trimmed at the bottom and come back on request

shell script: the attach button posts pick-attachments, an image paste posts attach-image with its base64 and is prevented, a text paste is untouched, chips render from attachments-pending with a remove control, and a blank box with chips submits
shell: the attach button is icon-only with an aria-label, sits first in the status bar, and the content security policy is unchanged
shell script: a chip click on a sent message posts open-attachment, and the error sentence is shown and cleared

transcript-row: a diff row without replaces appends a widget stamped with its row index; one with replaces redraws the widget of that sid and keeps it open; a withdrawn one hides it; one for an unknown or trimmed sid changes nothing
transcript-row: a marker row appends the same line a restored marker row draws
diff widget: a diff row in a session-restored window and in a transcript-page is appended as a widget

chat shell: the outbox band is present only with the queue, and the queue hint replaces the input placeholder only with it; an outbox message draws its rows and summary and each action posts its seq; with the queue a submit does not mark the turn running
a retrying row shows 'attempt n of 3', a countdown, a retry-now button and a cancel button, and retry-now posts outbox-retry-now with its seq
chat shell: the progress widget is never hidden: idle at the start, working after turn-running, idle after done, error, Stop and session-restored
session restore uses stored phase and elapsed time without another provider event
chat shell binds Stop to a pending run before the provider spawns
chat shell: an informational line's done does not end a running turn, and the turn's own done and error still do

a live row rendered by the registry while the view is scrolled up leaves scrollTop unchanged and trims nothing, even with more than 300 rows held

a live row rendered by the registry while the view is at the bottom moves the view to the bottom; with more than 300 rows held the oldest nodes are then removed back to a user row leaving about 200, and the view is still at the bottom
one turn longer than 300 rows is trimmed by a plain cut, and a pending tool row in the removed range is dropped so a later result renders as its own row
pager reset: a restore sets the first held index and total and ends at the bottom

pager prepend: an older page is rendered above the held rows in transcript order, keyed r<absolute index>; scrollTop grows by exactly the height added and the view is never moved to the bottom while the page renders
pager prepend: a page for another session, or whose before is not the first held index, is discarded and adds no row
trimmed rows render again when their page comes back: the dropped keys are forgotten, so appendKeyed renders new nodes

pager load request: one load-older is sent for the first held index on a bar click or a scroll to the top; no second request is sent while one is loading; the flag clears on the matching page, on a restore and after 5 seconds
returning to the bottom with more than 300 rows held runs the trim from the scroll listener
a row that throws while an older page renders falls back, and following is switched back on afterwards
the 'load earlier' bar is shown only when the first held index is above 0, names the count of older rows, and appears after a trim

rows that are appended empty and filled afterwards are still followed: the view stays at the bottom through a long run and a restore, the trim still runs, and a reader who scrolls up is left alone until they return
